description: Public pages cyberpunk redesign: /servers, /servers/[guildId] (server hub), /servers/[guildId]/tournaments (catalogue), /servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId] (detail), /servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/bracket, /servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/register, /servers/[guildId]/leaderboards, /servers/[guildId]/winners, /servers/[guildId]/winners/[tournamentId]. All pages keep existing Prisma queries, auth checks, and data shapes untouched. Only JSX, styling, and animation layers are changed. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: 1. Upgrade apps/web/src/app/servers/page.tsx. Keep all fetch('/api/servers') logic, error/loading/data states. Visual upgrades: page header 'YOUR SERVERS' in NeonText; add CyberBreadcrumb at top; skeleton loading state uses GlassCard with a scanline shimmer instead of bare Skeleton; ServerCard component (apps/web/src/components/server/ServerCard.tsx) — read it first, then upgrade: add tournament-card-glow border animation, neon server icon ring, live tournament count displayed as a Badge 'live' variant, upcoming as Badge 'upcoming'; empty state gets a NeonText headline and GlowButton 'cyber' variant for the 'Add Bot' CTA. Files: apps/web/src/app/servers/page.tsx, apps/web/src/components/server/ServerCard.tsx

2. Upgrade apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/page.tsx (server hub). Keep all Prisma queries (liveTournaments, upcomingTournaments, recentWinners) and admin check. Visual upgrades: server icon gets a neon-border-violet ring and float animation; section headers 'LIVE TOURNAMENTS' / 'UPCOMING TOURNAMENTS' / 'RECENT CHAMPIONS' use NeonText + live-indicator dot for the live section; TournamentCard inline component (defined in this file) — upgrade: add tournament-card-glow, neon badge on status, mono date display; CyberBreadcrumb showing Home > Servers > {server.name}; Admin Dashboard button uses GlowButton 'cyber' variant; add a server stat strip (live count, upcoming count, recent winners count) as GlassCard hud cards below the header. File: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/page.tsx

3. Read apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/page.tsx then upgrade it (or create it if minimal — check first). Add NeonText page header 'TOURNAMENT CATALOGUE', CyberBreadcrumb, filter tabs (All/Live/Upcoming/Completed) as GlowButton 'ghost' toggle group, TournamentCatalogue component upgrade if needed. Also upgrade apps/web/src/components/tournament/TournamentCard.tsx: add tournament-card-glow conic border, game-coloured accent top stripe, registration progress bar with neon gradient fill, start date in JetBrains Mono, 'REGISTER NOW' CTA as GlowButton primary on hover overlay. Files: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/page.tsx, apps/web/src/components/tournament/TournamentCard.tsx

4. Upgrade apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/page.tsx (tournament detail). Keep all Prisma queries (registrations, stages, matches, scoreEvents). Visual upgrades: hero banner section: if bannerUrl exists show Image with a neon gradient overlay; if not, show an animated gradient mesh with game colours + tournament name in NeonText glitch=true; registration progress bar upgrade: neon gradient fill with animated shimmer, fill percentage in mono text; match schedule table: alternating neon row highlights, status badges using upgraded Badge component, live rows get live-indicator pulsing; standings table: top 3 rows get podium styling (gold/silver/bronze neon accents, float animation for #1); add CyberBreadcrumb (Home > Servers > {server} > Tournaments > {name}); 'Register Your Team' button uses GlowButton primary with a neon pulse. File: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/page.tsx

5. Read apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/bracket/page.tsx and apps/web/src/components/tournament/Bracket.tsx then upgrade: add NeonText header, CyberBreadcrumb; bracket lines get neon violet colour; match boxes become GlassCard neonColor='violet' with winner highlighted in neon green; loser highlighted in neon red/dimmed. Files: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/bracket/page.tsx, apps/web/src/components/tournament/Bracket.tsx

6. Read apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/register/page.tsx then upgrade: RegistrationForm component (apps/web/src/components/tournament/RegistrationForm.tsx) — read first; upgrade form fields to use GlassCard hud containers for field groups, neon input focus rings (focus:border-[#7c3aed] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#7c3aed]/50), GlowButton primary submit, NeonText form header. Files: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/register/page.tsx, apps/web/src/components/tournament/RegistrationForm.tsx

7. Upgrade apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/leaderboards/page.tsx and apps/web/src/components/tournament/LeaderboardsClient.tsx. Keep all Prisma aggregation logic. Visual upgrades: NeonText 'LEADERBOARDS' header with glitch; game filter tabs as GlowButton toggles; leaderboard table rows get rank-specific neon: rank 1 = gold glow, rank 2 = silver glow, rank 3 = bronze glow, rest = standard; animated counter on total points column; add a podium top-3 graphic above the table using the existing podium CSS classes. Files: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/leaderboards/page.tsx, apps/web/src/components/tournament/LeaderboardsClient.tsx

8. Upgrade apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/winners/page.tsx and apps/web/src/components/tournament/WinnersPodium.tsx. Keep Prisma queries. Visual upgrades: WinnersPodium — gold/silver/bronze platform heights with NeonText names, trophy icon in neon gold, float animation (.podium-first/.podium-second/.podium-third already in globals.css — use them); per-tournament results list links use tournament-card-glow hover; 'HALL OF FAME' in NeonText glitch. Files: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/winners/page.tsx, apps/web/src/components/tournament/WinnersPodium.tsx

9. Read apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/winners/[tournamentId]/page.tsx and apps/web/src/components/tournament/WinnerDetailPodium.tsx then upgrade: full podium with neon-styled placement badges, confetti-style particle burst on load (use a lightweight CSS keyframe animation — no extra lib), NeonText tournament name, CyberBreadcrumb. Files: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/winners/[tournamentId]/page.tsx, apps/web/src/components/tournament/WinnerDetailPodium.tsx
acceptance_criteria: All 9 public page files and their component files compile without error
No Prisma queries, API calls, or auth logic were modified
Leaderboard top 3 rows use rank-specific neon colour
WinnersPodium uses existing podium-first/second/third float animations
